typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	BatchId as integer (),
	BossDataSource as string (),
	BossInitialCatalog as string (),
	BossPassword as string (),
	BossUserName as string (),
	CriticalEventSeverityID as integer (),
	dtAccLKP as string (),
	EventTypeID as integer (),
	FacetsDataSource as string (),
	FacetsPassword as string (),
	FacetsUserID as string (),
	GBD_EGR_Accounts as string (),
	GBD_EGR_FLDR as string (),
	GBD_EGR_Outbound as string (),
	GBD_EGR_Template as string (),
	gv_ExcelACLKPFileName as string (),
	gv_ExcelACLKPOutFileName as string (),
	gv_ExcelACLKPTemplate as string (),
	InfoEventSeverityID as integer (),
	ModuleID as integer (),
	OutputFileName as string (),
	OutputFilepath as string (),
	RowCount as integer ()
}

source(output(
		DummyColumn as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> InputPlaceHolderScriptComponent
InputPlaceHolderScriptComponent derive(T1 = 'T,',
		T2 = right(lpad('', 15, '0') + toString($RowCount), 15)) ~> TRAILERDerivedColumn
TRAILERDerivedColumn derive(TRAILER = T1 + T2) ~> TRAILER
TRAILER sink(input(
		Column_0 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Column_0 = TRAILER)) ~> FlatFileDestination
